description: This source file implements the WebAudioPlayer IPC interface for the Rialto client, including factory methods, IPC channel management, event subscription, and control functions such as play, pause, setEos, buffer management, device info, and volume control.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating WebAudioPlayer IPC instances.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Implementation of the factory for WebAudioPlayer IPC objects.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc
classes.description: Main class implementing the WebAudioPlayer IPC interface, managing IPC communication, event handling, and control commands.

methods.name: getFactory
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the WebAudioPlayerIpcFactory singleton.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates a new WebAudioPlayerIpc instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Constructor initializing the IPC module, attaching channel, and creating the web audio player.

methods.name: ~WebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources, destroying the web audio player, detaching channel, and resetting thread.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for IPC communication.

methods.name: onPlaybackStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles playback state update events and notifies the client.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Sends a play command to the web audio player.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Sends a pause command to the web audio player.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets end-of-stream on the web audio player.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer of audio data to the player.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info such as preferred/max frames and deferred play support.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a new web audio player with specified MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Destroys the current web audio player instance.
